message.content:
Explore the NINEONELABS renewal project at c:\Users\edn_y\renew_nineonelabs. I need to understand the existing responsive design system and patterns.

Please find and read:
1. resource/scss/abstract/ — all files (mixins, variables, breakpoints)
2. resource/scss/style.scss — overall structure
3. resource/scss/pages/_sub.scss — the sub-page SCSS (this is likely the main file for sub pages including works)
4. resource/scss/pages/_main.scss — if it has responsive patterns
5. Any existing mq() mixin usage across SCSS files — search for "@include mq" to find patterns

For each file/pattern found:
- List all breakpoint names and pixel values
- Show the mq() mixin signature
- Note existing responsive patterns for list/card/gallery layouts
- Note any page-specific responsive blocks already present

Also check resource/ts/runtime/ for ResponsiveRuntime — read it to understand isMobile definition.

Report the full breakpoint system, mixin signature, and at least 2-3 concrete examples of existing responsive blocks. Keep it concise but complete.
